author: mzf11125
content:
Hey everyone, I just opened a ERC for Confidential Agent Policy Verdicts.

It allows an agent to prove its action was checked against a policy without revealing what the policy says. An off-chain engine runs the check inside a zkVM and outputs a verifiable verdict to an on-chain Guard contract. It builds on ERC-7812 (commitments) and ERC-8004 (agent identity), and the reference implementation is partially working end-to-end.

I'm curious to hear your thoughts on interoperability and the trade-offs of off-chain zkVM evaluation.

Repo: https://github.com/zexoverz/confidential-agent-policy-verdicts

PR: https://github.com/ethereum/ERCs/pull/1919

Ethereum Magicians: https://ethereum-magicians.org/t/erc-8354-confidential-agent-policy-verdicts/29088/
